headline: Obelisk Deck for Duel Links
title: Obelisk the Tormentor Deck | Duel Links Cards and Skill | Yu-Gi-Oh Duel Links
video_script: Here is how to build an Obelisk the Tormentor deck in Duel Links. Obelisk has no meta deck right now, so this is a fun build with cards you can really get. Obelisk has four thousand attack, as much as your starting Life Points. Nobody can target it with card effects, and Tributing two monsters destroys all your opponent's monsters. The Skill is Memories of a Pharoah, for Kaiba from Dark Side of Dimensions. From turn three, the card you draw is Obelisk. Your deck must start with three Blue-Eyes White Dragon. That turn, one Blue-Eyes White Dragon counts as three Tributes for Obelisk. But if you Tribute only one Blue-Eyes, Obelisk is sent to the Graveyard at the end of the turn. Ra's Disciple gives three Tributes for the summon, but it cannot be Tributed for Obelisk's field wipe. Keep other monsters for that. Egyptian God Slime counts as three Tributes by itself. Tribute Metal Reflect Slime to bring it out from your Extra Deck. Monster Reborn can bring Obelisk back, but a Special Summoned Obelisk is sent to the Graveyard in the End Phase. Which card would you add? Comment below!
